title: Forest Gate
intro: Victorian streets on the edge of Epping Forest's southern flats, with a City of London park and cemetery and a tidal mill on the River Lea not far away.

items.name: West Ham Park
items.blurb: A Victorian park looked after by the City of London, with ornamental gardens, a playground and cricket pitches.
items.tip: The ornamental gardens are the prettiest corner.

items.name: Three Mills
items.blurb: A group of historic mills on an island in the River Lea, including the House Mill of 1776, one of the largest tide mills in the world.
items.tip: The House Mill opens on some Sundays for tours.

items.name: Jubilee Pond, Wanstead Flats
items.blurb: A restored pond at the southern edge of Wanstead Flats, a short walk from Forest Gate, with open grassland all around.
items.tip: Good for a sunset walk across the flats.
